messages:
maya: Huge thanks to @chris and @sam for rescuing the demo at the client meeting this morning. Coffee + vibes saved the day :tada:
chris: not alone — shoutout to @taylor for the quick docs update too. :raised_hands:
sam: also huge props to @support for the log pull and timeline, you were the real MVPs 👏
ops-bot: Incident note: hotfix deployed at 09:12, rollback avoided. (automated)
taylor: Team lunch on me tomorrow? Either tacos 🌮, ramen 🍜, or potluck 🥗. React with :taco:, :ramen:, :green_salad: to vote.
maya: also passing along the 'kudos mug' to whoever shipped the grouped alerts — that made triage so much faster.
chris: @maya you mean the new alert grouping? that was @sam's idea. :coffee:
sam: passing mug to @support for staying calm with the client. :mug:
jordan: jumping in from sales — big thanks! those new latency numbers in the deck were gold and helped close the follow-up call. :star_struck:
maya: ok this is getting wholesome. :heart:
ops-bot: poll tally (automated): 🌮 4, 🍜 2, 🥗 1 — tacos win!
chris: tacos it is. I'll drop a reminder in #lunch-orders and add a quick sign-up sheet (link coming).
taylor: thanks everyone — small wins like this make a big difference. :sparkles:
support: thanks team. happy to jump on post-mortem notes later if helpful.
maya: love this. passing the kudos chain to whoever helped with the monitoring dashboard tweaks last sprint. :chain:
chris: tagging @sam again — and also @taylor for the doc sprint. let's keep the streak going! :confetti_ball:
